pages.text: $(l)Rare combs.$() Some bees now and then bring home a second, rarer comb. It rolls first on every trip; if it misses, the bee's own comb rolls.$(br2)$(l)Bone Honeycomb$() ($(l:lesser/desert)Desert Bee$(/l)): 1 in 20, about 10.5 per hive-hour. Used for: Bone Block.

$(l)Budding Amethyst Honeycomb$() ($(l:bubba/amethyst)Amethyst Bee$(/l)): 1 in 150, about 1.40 per hive-hour. Used for: Budding Amethyst.$(br2)$(l)Echo Honeycomb$() ($(l:bubba/deep_dark)Deep Dark Bee$(/l)): 1 in 60, about 3.51 per hive-hour. Used for: Echo Shard, Sculk Catalyst, Sculk Shrieker.$(br2)$(l)Nautilus Honeycomb$() ($(l:bubba/sea)Sea Bee$(/l)): 1 in 20, about 10.5 per hive-hour. Used for: Nautilus Shell.

$(l)Sad Honeycomb$() ($(l:bubba/soul)Soul Bee$(/l)): 1 in 20, about 10.5 per hive-hour. Used for: Wither Rose, Crying Obsidian, Ghast Tear.$(br2)$(l)Comb rolls.$() Two bees roll for their own comb: the $(l:celestial/diamond)Diamond Bee$(/l) (1 in 4) and the $(l:celestial/ancient_debris)Ancient Debris Bee$(/l) (1 in 6). A failed roll brings home nothing. Every other bee brings its comb home every trip.

$(l)Home dimension.$() Nether bees work at half speed outside the Nether, the ender bee outside the End, and every other bee outside the Overworld.$(br2)$(l)Home biome.$() Most biome bees spend 20% less time in a hive in their home biome. The royal queen gives the same boost; they don't stack.
$(l)Day and weather.$() Overworld bees work in daytime and dry weather. Starlight bees work only at night. In the Nether and the End bees work all the time.
